title: Prod-ready runway: SDK & API sample distribution, comms, and rollout checklist
creator: Maya Ortiz
description: Coordinate the final pre-launch activities for the SDK + API surface that includes function-calling, structured output, and streaming samples. This ticket captures the distribution plan for code samples, a comms matrix for internal and external stakeholders, release notes draft, and the cross-team checklist for production readiness (QA, perf, security review, and support runbook). Aim is to have artifacts staged in the docs repo, sample repos, and PRs merged by the due date.
acceptance_criteria: All sample repositories (node, python, go) have working examples for function-calling, structured output, and streaming with CI green
Release notes draft reviewed by Engineering, Docs, and Legal and staged in release-notes/sdks/2025-02
Comms matrix completed with owners for blog post, changelog entry, customer emails, and social snippets
Support runbook and troubleshooting guide added to Console/Observability playbooks
Security review checklist marked complete and any findings triaged or scheduled
tasks: Finalize streaming sample that demonstrates chunked responses and reconnect handling - assignee: Li Wei (ENG)
Add structured output schema example with validator and tests - assignee: Priya Singh (ENG)
Create Function Calling end-to-end sample showing tool declaration + call flow - assignee: Roberto Diaz (ENG)
Prepare cross-language quickstart snippets (README badges, code sandbox links) - assignee: Docs team
Draft release notes blurb and technical appendix - assignee: Maya Ortiz
Prepare customer-facing migration notes for breaking changes and compatibility - assignee: Solutions Engineering
Run performance smoke tests on hosted and dedicated profiles and attach trace snapshots - assignee: Reliability team
Open final PRs to docs and samples repos and obtain approvals - assignee: Evan Brooks
stakeholders: Engineering: Evan Brooks, Li Wei, Priya Singh, Roberto Diaz
launch_steps: Week -2: Finalize samples and CI; security review kickoff
Week -1: Docs staging, release notes draft, internal beta announcement to selected customers
Day 0 AM: Merge docs and sample PRs after signoff; schedule publish window for 09:00 PST
Day 0 AM (post-merge): Deploy docs site staging -> production; verify sample artifacts load
Day 0 PM: Publish changelog and broadcast blog + customer emails; enable first-party monitoring dashboards
Day 1-7: Monitor metrics (errors, latency, adoption), triage any regressions, and prepare hotfix PRs if needed
release_notes_blurb: SDKs and API: GA of expanded SDK surface with function-calling, structured output schemas, and streaming examples. Includes cross-language quickstarts, performance notes, and recommended integration patterns. See technical appendix for migration tips and compatibility matrix.
risks: Streaming sample exhibits flakiness under CI on older kernels - mitigation: add retry harness and limit concurrency in example
Security review surfaces credential handling guidance changes - mitigation: patch docs and require KMS integration example
Docs site index latency during publish window - mitigation: throttle staging publishes and pre-warm CDN
followups: Post-launch adoption dashboard spike analysis (owner: Developer Relations)
Collect 3 customer reference integrations for case studies (owner: Solutions Engineering)
Schedule retrospective and lessons learned in Cycle 2025-W09
